column1: # Search keywords of the SUPER+/ menu and the reading page: regex <TAB> words. A row gets the words when the regex (case-insensitive,
# re.search) matches its description + its block title, so "screen shot" finds the "Screenshot ..." binds and "password" finds the
# Bitwarden pickers. The words are searched next to keys, description and block (the row shows only the description). Every regex must
# match at least one row (`keymap check` fails on a stale rule); add a line when a natural word finds nothing.
